example.title: Derelict two-storey motel, Mendocino County (photographed April 2009)

brief: An abandoned early-1970s two-storey motel: a long block of grey board siding with dark window trim, rows of doors along a covered upper gallery with a low rail and a dark shed roof, a cracked asphalt car park with faded parking lines. One photo; worn and boarded. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
